title: Enable middle-button scrolling for TrackPoint (evdev)
summary: Configure the TrackPoint to scroll by holding the middle button. This applies to systems using the evdev driver; libinput users usually have this enabled by default.
prerequisites: Using X11 with the evdev driver
Know your TrackPoint device name (e.g., 'TPPS/2 IBM TrackPoint')
